entries.jp: {v:0005}ここの床の色も変わってる‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0005}The floor here is a different color too...

entries.jp: {v:0006}ということは、重力を制御するものが{n}どこかにあるはずじゃ。
entries.en: {v:0006}Then there must be something controlling gravity{n}somewhere about here, eh?
{v:0007}Hmm, let's see...

entries.jp: {v:0008}あ、あった！{n}アレだ！
entries.en: {v:0008}Oh, found it! There it is!

entries.jp: {v:0009}送魔線張りひとすじ４０年。最後の仕事じゃ！{n}行くぞ、若者たちよ！
entries.en: {v:0009}Forty years devoted to laying mana lines. This is my{n}last job! Come along, you youngsters!

entries.jp: {FFEE}送魔線技師を守りながら戦え！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Fight while protecting the Mana Line Engineer!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0033}入ってきたのがあそこだから、{n}指向性を、こう変えて‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0033}We came in over there, so if I adjust the direction{n}like this...

entries.jp: {v:0034}お、やっと魔力の反応があったぞ！{n}あと一息じゃ！
entries.en: {v:0034}Ah, finally a magical response! Just a little more now!

entries.jp: {v:0036}どうじゃ、やったぞ！{p}{v:0037}さぁ、遠慮なく化け物を倒してくれ！
entries.en: {v:0036}How's that? I did it!{p}{v:0037}Now, go and finish off those monsters!

entries.jp: {v:0038}さんきゅ～！{n}おじちゃん！
entries.en: {v:0038}Thaaanks, mister!

entries.jp: それじゃ、わしゃ、先に帰るぞ。{n}フェザリアンにでも送ってもらうわい。
entries.en: Well then, this old fellow will head back first. I'll get a{n}Featherian to take me, or some such.

entries.jp: {v:000A}ねぇ、ねぇ、なんだかこっちに向かってきてる{n}気がするんだけど‥‥。
entries.en: {v:000A}Hey, hey! Is it just me, or are they coming this way...?

entries.jp: {v:000B}ねぇ‥。{n}このゲヴェルもどき、こっちに来るみたいなんだけど。
entries.en: {v:000B}Um... That creature that looks like Gevel seems to be{n}coming this way.

entries.jp: {v:000C}ん？{n}奴ら、俺を狙ってるのか？
entries.en: {v:000C}Hm? Are those things after me?

entries.jp: {v:000E}あのモンスター、アタシを狙ってるような‥‥。
entries.en: {v:000E}That monster seems to have its eye on me...

entries.jp: {v:000D}モンスターが僕を狙っているような気がするが‥‥。
entries.en: {v:000D}I have a feeling that monster is targeting me...

entries.jp: {v:000F}なんだか、モンスターが{n}私を狙っているような気がします‥‥。
entries.en: {v:000F}Somehow, I get the feeling that monster is after me...

entries.jp: {v:0010}何だ？{n}化け物が俺に向かってるようだが‥‥。{p}{v:0011}気のせいか？
entries.en: {v:0010}What? That monster looks like it's heading for me...{p}{v:0011}Or am I imagining it?

entries.jp: {v:0012}気のせいかも知れませんが、{n}モンスターが僕のところへ来るみたいに{n}思えるんですけど。
entries.en: {v:0012}I might be imagining things, but it looks as though that{n}monster is coming toward me.

entries.jp: {v:0013}化け物が私の方に来るように思えるのだが‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0013}That monster appears to be approaching me...

entries.jp: {v:0014}アタシ達との違いは‥‥。{p}{FC02}{v:0015}やっぱり、あの匂い袋のせいだよ！
entries.en: {v:0014}What makes them different from the rest of us...?{p}{FC02}{v:0015}I knew it! It's that scent pouch!

entries.jp: {v:0016}やっぱりあの匂い袋を持っている奴を狙ってるのか？
entries.en: {v:0016}So they really are after whoever's carrying that{n}scent pouch?

entries.jp: {v:0017}だったら、匂い袋を受け渡しすれば、{n}上手くモンスターを誘導できるんじゃない？
entries.en: {v:0017}Then couldn't we lead the monsters around by passing{n}the scent pouch back and forth?

entries.jp: {v:0018}その作戦は使えるかもな。
entries.en: {v:0018}That plan might work.

entries.jp: 重力障壁操作パネルがある。{n}どこに合わせますか？
entries.en: There is a gravity barrier control panel. Which setting{n}will you choose?

...{v:002C}Hm? No response...

entries.jp: {v:002E}どうしたんですか？

entries.jp: {v:002F}うむ、ここまで魔力を送信することが出来んようじゃ。
entries.en: {v:002F}Hmm, seems the magical power can't be transmitted{n}this far.

entries.jp: {v:0030}えぇっ！？{n}ど、どうすんのよ！
entries.en: {v:0030}Whaaat?! Wh-what are we supposed to do?!

entries.jp: {v:0031}調整しなければダメじゃな。{n}もう少し待ってくれ！
entries.en: {v:0031}I'll have to make some adjustments, then. Give me a{n}little more time!
{v:0032}We're counting on you!

entries.jp: {v:0040}やれやれ、やっとたどり着いたわい。{p}{v:0041}ワシはこれで帰らせてもらう。{n}後はお前さんたち次第じゃ！{p}{v:0042}がんばってくれよ！
entries.en: {v:0040}Whew, finally made it, eh?{p}{v:0041}I'll be heading back now. The rest is up to{n}you youngsters!{p}{v:0042}Give it your best!

entries.jp: {v:0043}ありがとね、おじちゃん！
entries.en: {v:0043}Thanks, mister!

entries.jp: {v:0044}人生で一番の思い出になったわい。
entries.en: {v:0044}Ah, this'll be the finest memory of my life.

entries.en: {v:003E}I'm sorry... If only we'd done a better job...

entries.jp: {v:003F}じいさんの死は無駄にしないぜ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:003F}We won't let the old man die for nothing...
